title: Re-did Berrus engine from scratch to support the new vision, mix of RS+PoE+Tibia.
author: v1dal
selftext:
As the title says, current game (https://berrus.app, +1K characters created, live for 9 months) is a pure idle game with some online bits (trade, rankings...), but as I prepared the next version I realized I had to be more ambitious so I redid the engine from scratch, full authoritative, tile based...

Here is a small peek at the visuals, has shaders that change during the day/night cycle, clouds, tempests etc...

As a side note, I think the engine I build is really cool, and I could branch it to create any other cool online game like zombie survival with base building etc...
